stories.title: Leone XIV in Francia, grande Messa a Place de la Concorde: "Sento che avete sete di pace"

en.title: Pope Francis XIV in France, grand Mass at Place de la Concorde: "I sense you thirst for peace"
en.summary: Pope Francis XIV held a large Mass in Paris attended by 800,000 people on the Champs-Élysées and emphasized that history is shaped by those who initiate peace processes rather than apparent victors. He is scheduled to travel to Lourdes later.

stories.title: 15enne trovato morto ai piedi di un traliccio dell'alta tensione nelle campagne di Lodi

en.title: 15-year-old found dead at base of high-voltage pylon in Lodi countryside
en.summary: A 15-year-old boy was discovered deceased near an electrical tower in rural Lodi. Investigators are considering both violent crime and a dangerous social media challenge as possible causes of death.

stories.title: Trump, 'forse Putin e Zelensky faranno un accordo prima del pieno inverno'

en.title: Trump, 'perhaps Putin and Zelensky will reach an agreement before deep winter'
en.summary: US President Trump suggested that Putin and Zelensky might achieve a peace accord before the onset of winter, according to Bloomberg reporting.

stories.title: Trump conferma, ho respinto la proposta dell'Iran

en.title: Trump confirms he rejected Iran's proposal
en.summary: President Trump confirmed he rejected a proposal from Iran, as previously reported by the Wall Street Journal.

stories.title: Siracusano, sottosegretaria FI: "Vannacci mi ha spogliata con l'IA. Che viltà, lo denuncio"

en.title: Siracusano, FI undersecretary: "Vannacci stripped me with AI. What cowardice, I'm reporting him"
en.summary: A Forza Italia politician accused former general Vannacci of using artificial intelligence to create inappropriate content about her during an electoral campaign. Senior party officials condemned the action as vulgar and unacceptable.

stories.title: Russell vince a Baku davanti a Verstappen. Antonelli da 16° a 5°, Ferrari giù dal podio

en.title: Russell wins in Baku ahead of Verstappen. Antonelli from 16th to 5th, Ferrari off the podium
en.summary: Russell led the entire Azerbaijan Grand Prix from start to finish in his Mercedes. His teammate Verstappen recovered to second place while maintaining his championship lead, and Ferrari failed to secure a podium finish.

stories.title: GP Azerbaijan: Russell domina a Baku, Verstappen secondo, Antonelli chiude quinto

en.title: Azerbaijan GP: Russell dominates in Baku, Verstappen second, Antonelli finishes fifth
en.summary: Russell dominated the Azerbaijan Grand Prix while Verstappen secured second place and maintained his world championship lead despite losing ground. Ferrari missed the podium for the fifth consecutive race.

stories.title: Gp Azerbaigian: trionfo Russell in volata su Verstappen, Antonelli rimonta ed è 5°

en.title: Azerbaijan GP: Russell's triumph in a close race over Verstappen, Antonelli climbs to 5th
en.summary: Russell won the Azerbaijan Grand Prix in a closely fought contest with Verstappen, with safety car periods creating dramatic moments. Ferrari missed the podium for the fourth consecutive race while the championship leader extended his advantage.

stories.title: "Non è Brad Pitt", il video postato da Fiorello per il suo ritorno su Rai 1

en.title: "It's Not Brad Pitt", the video posted by Fiorello for his return to Rai 1
en.summary: Italian entertainer Fiorello announced his return to Rai 1 through a mysterious video posted online, though details about what he will host remain undisclosed.

stories.title: Fiorello, ritorno a sorpresa su Rai1. L’annuncio in un video social

en.title: Fiorello, surprise return to Rai1. The announcement in a social video
en.summary: Fiorello posted a video on Instagram announcing a surprise return to Rai1, with uncertainty remaining about whether his previous show will resume.

stories.title: Guerra Ucraina - Russia, news. Trump: “Voglio che Zelensky e Putin si accordino”

en.title: Ukraine-Russia War - news. Trump: "I want Zelensky and Putin to reach an agreement"
en.summary: Reports indicate the US and Russia are blocking limitations on artificial intelligence use in weapons. Russian officials are in New York for economic cooperation discussions, and a Lavrov-Wadephul meeting took place at the UN General Assembly.

stories.title: A Zelensky l’ok di Trump per i Patriot, ma Putin frena sui negoziati: “Colpa degli attacchi di Kiev”

en.title: Zelensky gets Trump's approval for Patriot, but Putin slows negotiations: "Fault of Kiev's attacks"
en.summary: Trump approved Patriot systems for Zelensky while Putin stated Russia is not waging war on Europe and blamed Ukrainian attacks for halting peace talks.

stories.title: Caputi: «Trasformare l’attrattività dell’Italia in ricchezza diffusa»

en.title: Caputi: "Transform Italy's attractiveness into widespread wealth"
en.summary: An end-of-term agreement with the government includes a simplification decree to convert Italy's appeal into broader economic benefits.

stories.title: Fondi UE, il rischio di fare bene le cose sbagliate: la riforma che cambia le regole di valutazione dal 2028

en.title: EU Funds, the risk of doing well the wrong things: the reform that changes evaluation rules from 2028
en.summary: European Union fund evaluation methods are being reformed, changing how results are measured, counted, and verified starting in 2028. The reform is among several policy matters under discussion in Brussels for the upcoming budget cycle.

stories.title: Grimaldi: «Investiremo 3 miliardi sulle navi del futuro»

en.title: Grimaldi: "We will invest 3 billion on ships of the future"
en.summary: Grimaldi announces a 3 billion investment in future ship development. The company reports solid results in 2025 despite a challenging economic environment.

stories.title: In Calabria, Sardegna e Sicilia i primi treni a idrogeno a scartamento ridotto al mondo

en.title: In Calabria, Sardinia and Sicily the world's first narrow-gauge hydrogen trains
en.summary: Swiss company Stadler has manufactured 21 hydrogen-powered trains for three Italian regional operators: 10 for Sardinian regional transport, 9 for Calabrian railways, and 2 for Sicilian Circumetnea railway.

stories.title: Sui costruttori la scure degli extra-costi

en.title: Construction companies face the burden of extra costs
en.summary: Construction industry representatives report that material costs including concrete, plastic, bitumen, and electrical cables continue rising, eroding profits and reducing available liquidity.
